name: IMAP and POP3 Security Checklist
source: CIS Mail Controls + NIST 800-45 + RFC hardening guidance

items.description: Disable cleartext IMAP/POP3 access where policy requires encryption.
Validate secure listener configuration and negotiated cipher strength.
Assess downgrade resistance on opportunistic encryption paths.
Ensure certificates are valid, trusted, and correctly scoped.
Disable insecure authentication methods and legacy crypto.
Review advertised capabilities for unnecessary attack surface.
Protect folder/listing metadata from unauthorized disclosure.
Validate lockout, throttling, and anomaly defenses.

items.testName: MFA and modern auth integration checks
items.description: Prefer token-based auth where supported and required.

items.testName: Mailbox ACL and delegation policy review
items.description: Audit delegated mailbox access and role boundaries.
Disable stale mailboxes and reset risky accounts.

items.testName: Session timeout and token expiry controls
items.description: Enforce reauthentication and idle timeout policy.
Validate controls against privilege creep in shared mailboxes.
Separate operational and security administration roles.
Collect detailed mailbox access telemetry for investigations.
Alert on impossible travel, unusual devices, and atypical access times.
Validate protections for message alteration and unauthorized deletion.

items.testName: Data retention and legal hold controls
items.description: Verify retention, hold, and eDiscovery governance requirements.
Maintain patch cadence for mail services and integrations.
Test mailbox restore while preserving authorization boundaries.
Exercise mailbox compromise response and credential reset workflows.
